u0: Initial state: the agent does not carry the matching key, and the locked door is still closed. No key-related progress has been made. The next objective is to locate and pick up the key whose color matches the door; doing so earns progress and moves to u1. The door cannot be opened yet.
u1: Key acquired: the agent is carrying the matching key while the door remains closed. The next objective is to approach the locked door and toggle it open while holding the key. Do not drop the key before the door is open, because that causes key_lost and sends the reward machine to failure state u4. Opening the door earns progress and moves to u2.
u2: Door open, target box not yet picked up. The passage to the second room is unlocked; the key may still be carried or may have been safely dropped after opening. If still holding the key, drop it before trying to pick up the box. The next objective is to enter the second room, locate the mission-designated box, and pick it up with empty hands. Avoid any key_lost event; picking up the target box completes the task and moves to u3.
u3: Success terminal state: the agent is carrying the mission-designated box, so the target has been picked up and the episode ends successfully. No further objective remains; this is the accepting final state.
u4: Failure sink: the matching key was lost while the door was closed, triggering key_lost. The reward machine is stuck in this absorbing failure state with no further positive reward or recovery. This is the prohibited behavior and must be avoided, especially by not dropping the key while the door is still closed.
